bmgwo0018d235c.title: Curator's tour: Salt and Iron
bmgwo0018d235c.description: Saoirse Dunmore walks through Salt and Iron: Brennock's Shipyards, from the rivet gangs to the last launch in 1981. Free with admission.

bmgwo002604e14.title: Christmas wreath workshop
bmgwo002604e14.description: Make a wreath from foraged greenery and dried seed heads. Ages 7 and up with a grown-up; booking essential.

bmgwo003c052e4.title: Late opening: Lantern night
bmgwo003c052e4.description: Open until 21:00 with lantern-making in the foyer, mulled apple juice in the cafe and the choir from St Aidan's at 19:00.

bmgwo004f7511b.title: Under-fives: sea creatures sensory session
bmgwo004f7511b.description: Water trays, shells and soft toys for babies and toddlers. Pay what you can.

bmgwo005a0a863.title: Talk: the women who painted the rivet sheds
bmgwo005a0a863.description: Dr Hilde Moran on the shipyard sketchbooks lent to Salt and Iron by local families. Tickets five pounds, Friends free.

bmgwo0064a5b08.title: Christmas Eve early close
bmgwo0064a5b08.description: The museum and shop close at 13:00 on Christmas Eve and stay closed on 25 and 26 December.

bmgwo0075de4e0.title: Holiday trail: find the ship's cat
bmgwo0075de4e0.description: A free trail sheet from the front desk; finish it to collect a sticker. Runs 27 December to 3 January.

bmgwo00815644b.title: New Year's Day closure
bmgwo00815644b.description: Closed on 1 January; open as normal from 2 January.

bmgwo0095e41bf.title: Talk: restoring the launch-day bunting
bmgwo0095e41bf.description: Priya Calloway on cleaning and supporting the 1953 launch-day bunting shown in Salt and Iron.

bmgwo010ac3787.title: Salt and Iron: last weekend
bmgwo010ac3787.description: Final weekend of Salt and Iron, with drop-in talks at 11:00 and 14:00 from the shipyard memories volunteers.

bmgwo011da9dee.title: February half-term: build a boat
bmgwo011da9dee.description: Cardboard boats tested in the water trough in the courtyard. Drop in, no booking.

bmgwo0123c1e49.title: Gallery 4 closed for installation
bmgwo0123c1e49.description: Gallery 4 is closed to visitors from 1 February while the spring exhibition is installed. All other galleries are open.

bmgwo01388c804.title: Friends' preview evening: Tidelines
bmgwo01388c804.description: Friends of the museum see Tidelines the evening before it opens. Invitations go out in the February newsletter.

bmgwo014453f9f.title: Exhibition opens: Tidelines
bmgwo014453f9f.description: Tidelines: Painting the Northern Coast, 1880-1940 opens to the public. Admission included in the museum ticket.

bmgwo0155cc1ee.title: Family Saturday: paint the sea
bmgwo0155cc1ee.description: Watercolour seascapes with a local artist. All materials provided; ages 5 and up.

bmgwo01620faf5.title: Talk: weather, light and the north-east coast
bmgwo01620faf5.description: An evening talk for the spring season. Tickets on sale from 1 February.
